name: All That Glitters Is Gold
source:
You've lived in a small town in the mountains all your life, surrounded by the festivities of old times and the warmth of the people that live there. Winter was always hard, yet, it became harder and harder, to the point it was unbearable. It never stopped, and it didn't look like it would.

You arm yourself with courage, and decide to go talk with the Gods at the Gods Altar, up in the mountain, under a never ending storm. Will you stop this never ending winter?

[Edited from [url=https://matthyy.itch.io/all-that-glitters-is-gold]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你从小到大一直住在山间的一座小镇里，身边围绕着传统的节庆氛围与当地居民的温情。这里的冬天向来难熬，可如今却变得越来越严酷，直至到了难以忍受的地步。寒冬从未停歇，而且看样子也毫无消退的迹象。

你鼓起勇气，决定冒着永不停息的暴风雪，登上山顶的诸神祭坛与神明对话。你能否终结这场永无止境的寒冬？

[整编自[url=https://matthyy.itch.io/all-that-glitters-is-gold]Itch.io[/url]]
